about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport SDV6 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport SDV6 was offered across two generations — the original L320 (2005–2013) and the L494 (2013–2022). Both use the same 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, the SDV6, which was also shared with the Range Rover and Discovery models of that era. The SDV6 is one of the most widely fitted diesel engines in the Land Rover range of the 2010s, and its timing chain and injector seal wear patterns are well documented by specialist workshops. The Range Rover Sport SDV6 was discontinued when the L461 generation launched in 2022, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace SDV6 engines for every Range Rover Sport SDV6 on the road.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport SDV6 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The Range Rover Sport SDV6 uses the same SDV6 engine across both generations, so compatibility is consistent throughout the production run. However, there are subtle differences in ancillaries and ECU calibration between the L320 and L494 that mean we always confirm your exact generation and specification via your registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
